title: Ciphertext-only narrow shifted period-match endpoint prior
rationale: Tests whether independently observed non-anchor positions fall on endpoints of a narrow ciphertext-only same-letter shifted period-match rule. This is not another public-anchor mining pass because discovery uses only raw K4 ciphertext self-coincidence structure, with public anchors used only as an exclusion mask. It differs from ciphertext-period-match-v1 by fixing only the top 3 shifted-match periods over periods 1 through 20 before any observation scoring.
prediction_target: Future source-backed non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in endpoints of the predeclared narrow shifted same-letter period-match sets.
discovery_inputs: Public K4 ciphertext self-coincidence profile for periods 1..=20.
Deterministic top-period selection by shifted same-letter match count and non-anchor endpoint coverage.
A fixed top-3 period endpoint set emitted before any source-backed observation scoring.
No candidate words, routes, plaintext claims, or additive fragment scoring.
evaluation_inputs: Validated source-backed non-anchor K4 position observations from an eligible source archive.
Seeded same-size non-anchor position-shuffle null over the best selected period-match set.
controls: Validate the deterministic prediction artifact before scoring.
Validate source-backed observation file and source review before scoring.
Exclude public anchor positions from target endpoint sets.
Use seeded same-size non-anchor position-shuffle null controls.
Interpret only with multiple-comparison context across all independent lanes.
